messages:
Sofia: heads up — finalizing run-of-show for next Wed webinar. want to lock speaker order and demo fallback plan by EOD tomorrow. link to doc: https://docs.google.com/example :spiral_calendar:
Raj: thx. can we add a 2-min intro about cost/latency tradeoffs? that’s our hook for product folks.
Mei: +1. also need to confirm who is running the live demo and who does the prerecorded fallback.
Tom: I can run live demo but prefer a short scripted prompt set. if GPUs act up, fallback to clip.
Alex: re fallback — Casey and I will stand by with the prerec clip (30s) and the slide that explains degraded-mode routing.
Casey: +1, ops will handle the routing message and trigger. what channel should attendees be routed to for follow-ups? #sales or #customer-success?
Raj: route qualified leads to #sales-leads, general questions to #support. we’ll add a short form for interested enterprises.
Sofia: Good. Run order proposal in doc: 1) Sofia intro (2m) 2) Raj product story (5m) 3) Tom live demo (10m) 4) Panel + Q&A (25m) 5) CTA + form (3m). Any edits?
Mei: Add a 1-slide health-check before demo with the checklist: 
```
- Verify Dedicated pool healthy
- Model version pinned (v2.1.0)
- Streaming enabled
- Fallback clip ready
```
Tom: copying that into my notes. Can someone paste the exact prerec clip filename?
Alex: prerec clip: "demo-fallback-2026-03-10.mp4" stored in 
GDrive > Events > WebinarAssets. Casey will have local copy too.
Casey: I’ll be on the call 10 mins early and keep the ops runbook open. I’ll post the failover trigger command in this thread if we need hot switch:
```
# ops: trigger fallback
deploybot trigger --clip demo-fallback-2026-03-10.mp4 --announce "Switching to prerecorded demo due to latency"
```
DeployBot: deploy scheduled check: GPU pool healthy = true, latency p95 = 220ms, capacity buffer = 30% :white_check_mark:
Sofia: great. rehearsal schedule — two dry runs: Tue 11a (full) and Wed 9a (quick). please RSVP in the doc.
Raj: speakers — please share final slides + script by Monday noon.
Mei: I’ll prepare the audience QA routing script and the slack post-click flow for the CTA form.
Tom: can we have one prompt set that’s guaranteed to be cache-friendly? posting example now: 
```
Prompt A: "Summarize this policy in 3 bullets for a product manager."
Prompt B: "Given these constraints, generate a short demo user session (<=150 tokens)."
```
Sofia: perfect. last bit — who’s monitoring the stream and chat during live?
Alex: I’ll monitor stream quality, Mei will monitor chat, Casey will handle any infra escalations, Raj will triage product questions.
Sofia: awesome. if no one objects I’ll lock the doc and send calendar invites. :thumbsup: we’ll reconfirm after Tue dry run.
Tom: sounds good — see you all at Tue 11a.
Mei: added RSVP ✅
Alex: copied. prepping backups.
Casey: ops ready.
Sofia: thanks team!
